---
title: "Milestone4_Sidney"
format: html
---

```{r message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(MetBrewer)
bestseller <- read_csv("../data/clean/full_bestseller.csv")
```

```{r}
clean <- bestseller %>% 
  group_by(title) %>%
  summarize(
    best_ranking = min(rank),
    max_weeks_on_list = max(weeks_on_list),
    publisher = first(publisher),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  
```

```{r}
clean %>% 
  group_by(publisher) %>%
  summarize(book_count = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(book_count)) %>%
  top_n(10, book_count) %>%
  left_join(clean, by = "publisher") %>%
  mutate(pub = fct_reorder(publisher, book_count)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = pub, fill = book_count)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_met_c("VanGogh1") +
  labs(title = "Top Publishing Companies on the 2021-2024 NYT Bestseller Lists", x = "Publisher", y = "Number of Unique Books on Bestseller List", subtitle = "Of the 718 Unique Titles") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  coord_flip()
```
